# AlaTex Landscaping
> Full-service landscaping company serving Greater Birmingham and West Alabama.

AlaTex Landscaping provides landscaping, landscape construction, drainage, retaining walls, outdoor lighting, and sprinkler repair for residential and commercial properties across the Birmingham metro and West Alabama. Owner-operated by Bryan Moore, the company began as a sprinkler repair business and grew into a complete residential and commercial landscaping operation. Fully licensed and insured.

## Services
- Landscape Construction (patios, walkways, outdoor living spaces, full installation)
- Retaining Walls (engineered block, boulder, and structural walls with drainage)
- Drainage & French Drain Installation (standing water, erosion, foundation protection)
- Outdoor Lighting (low-voltage landscape and architectural lighting)
- Sprinkler Repair (irrigation repair, tuning, and upgrades)
- Irrigation Systems (design, installation, smart controllers)
- Commercial Landscaping & Maintenance

## Service Area
Hoover, Vestavia Hills, Mountain Brook, Irondale, Tuscaloosa, and Northport, Alabama, plus the greater Birmingham metro and West Alabama.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What areas do you serve?**
We serve Hoover, Vestavia Hills, Mountain Brook, Irondale, Tuscaloosa, and Northport, Alabama, plus the greater Birmingham metro and West Alabama.

**What services do you offer?**
Landscaping, landscape construction, drainage and French drains, retaining walls, outdoor lighting, sprinkler repair, and irrigation systems for both residential and commercial properties.

**Do you build retaining walls?**
Yes. We design and build engineered segmental, boulder, and structural retaining walls with built-in drainage to hold slopes and stop erosion in the Birmingham metro's clay soils.

**Do you repair sprinkler systems?**
Yes. We repair, tune, and upgrade sprinkler and irrigation systems — broken heads, leaks, valves, and controllers — across all of our service areas.

**Are you licensed and insured?**
Yes, AlaTex Landscaping is fully licensed and insured.
